name: claude-ui
description: Desktop UI for managing Claude Code sessions: session list from ~/.claude, pin/group, embedded terminal, waiting-for-input nudges.
author: Jille

scripts.build:renderer: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.renderer.json && esbuild src/renderer/renderer.ts --bundle --format=esm --outfile=dist/renderer/renderer.js --sourcemap && cp src/renderer/index.html src/renderer/styles.css node_modules/@xterm/xterm/css/xterm.css dist/renderer/
scripts.build: npm run build:main && npm run build:renderer
